description: This header file declares the exported function prototypes for the Transport Layer Security (TLS) Record Keeper Object within the BroadWay Service Delivery System. It provides prototype definitions for creating, removing, enrolling objects, and initializing the Record Keeper component, indicating its role in TLS implementation.

methods.name: TlsCreateRecordKeeper
methods.description: Prototype for creating a TLS record keeper instance with specific container, owner, and reserved handles.

methods.name: TlsRkoCreate
methods.description: Prototype for creating the TLS Record Keeper object with specified context handles.

methods.name: TlsRkoRemove
methods.description: Prototype for removing the TLS Record Keeper object.

methods.name: TlsRkoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Prototype for enrolling objects within the TLS Record Keeper.

methods.name: TlsRkoInitialize
methods.description: Prototype for initializing the TLS Record Keeper object.
